services.name: Perch Charters
services.desc: Yellow Perch are of the abundance in Lake Erie and widely considered to be one of the more tasteful freshwater fish. The Lake Erie Perch is a yellow-gold fish with dark-striped sides and grows to be up to 15-inches in length - and perfect for a fun family outing. When a school of perch goes into a feeding frenzy, the fish can provide anglers with plenty of action, with the reward of a nice cooler of fine tasting fish for supper. Perch fishing can be very simple. Their small size, abundance and aggressive attitude make them a popular fish for young anglers. Lake Erie Perch are not picky eaters, especially when feeding.
